prerequisites.label: Function notation
prerequisites.description: Evaluate and interpret expressions like $f(2)$, $f(x+1)$, composition, and function outputs.

prerequisites.label: Algebra manipulation
prerequisites.description: Simplify expressions, factor common patterns, cancel valid factors, and work with rational expressions.

prerequisites.label: Graph reading
prerequisites.description: Read values, trends, holes, and approaching behavior from graphs or tables.

prerequisites.label: Exponents and logs
prerequisites.description: Use exponent and logarithm rules that appear throughout calculus.

prerequisites.label: Limits intuition
prerequisites.description: Understand what a function approaches, even when the function value is missing.

prerequisites.label: Continuity
prerequisites.description: Decide when a function is continuous and identify removable breaks.
